course_name: 微奈米量測系統與技術
outline: To introduce the advanced systems and technology associated with micro- and nano-scale measurement.
schedule:
Week 1 : Introduction
Week 2 : Optics
Week 3 : Light and Matter
Week 4 : Semiconductor Fabrication Evolution
Week 5 : Micro and nano-measurement - Confocal techniques
Week 6 : Micro and nano-measurement - Interferometry
Week 7 : Micro and nano-measurement - SEM
Week 8 : Micro and nano-measurement - AFM
Week 9 : Mid-term presentation
Week 10-14 : Spectrometer and Spectroscopy - UV-Vis, PL, Raman, FTIR.
Week 15-16 : Photoelectron spectroscopy
Week 17 : Student Practice
Week 18 : Final Exam
